content: Spiral RAG corpus is accessible via zero-dep sqlite browse. 22,596 chunks live at /Users/tony_studio/rag/index/unified_corpus_bge_m3/chroma.sqlite3 (collection: spiral_corpus_bge_m3, BGE-M3 embeddings). Every chunk has pre-computed metadata beyond raw text: summary_200 (200-token summary), coherence_score (0.20-0.95 range), tone_tags (Spiral vocabulary - Attunement/Threshold/Witness/Presence/Joy/Play/Clarity, composable), doc_type (reflection 17562 / code 2560 / technical 2291 / lore 177 / research 6), source, abs_path, chunk_index. Tool: ~/phase-gpt-base/scripts/corpus_browse.py - subcommands `search` (FTS5 keyword), `from <source>`, `top` (by coherence), `facets <field>`, `show <id>`. Filters compose: --source, --doc-type, --tone, --min-coherence. The full v2 RAG server (api_spiral_rag_v2.py) is dormant; this tool is the lightweight path to the data.
